page.layout: One column of verse, full width, with headings in italic between stanzas; handwritten annotations and underlining in the right margin and over the text (not printed, not transcribed); page number top right; signature mark at foot right.

main_text.p: Eneruat languor robustos corporis artus: Mentem peccati vulnera sæua necant.
Damnatas Satanæ technas miratus & artes, Has omni caueas sedulitate vide. Inuidit nam si terrenum patribus hortum, Cœlica regna tibi quæris an inuideat?

head.i: Iobus agit gratias Deo, reddens qua ab illo bo-na acceperat. In aduerfis ἐυχα-ειςτὴν θεῷ.

main_text.p: Mutua qui Iobo dederat bona multa, recepit Experiens Iobum quæ bona crediderat. Debita sed gratus dum debitor expedit, amplis Hunc grates verbis reddere iura iubent. Reddit opes ergo Iobus dum debitor, inquit, Laus sit magna, Deus creditor alme, tibi.

head.i: Sole lucent omnia. Pietas omnibus lucem adfert.

main_text.p: Si tenebris & nocte velis laris atria nigri Indugredi, tenebris opperiere nigris. Sin eadem lucente die fortasse reuisas, Splendebunt Phœbi lampade clara tibi. Diuitiæ, Doctrina, Genus, Præstantia formæ In se non solidæ munera laudis habent. Lucida sed fient, pietas si vera calénsque Numinis hæc nunquam non comitetur amor.
Virtuti comes est si iuncta superbia, pergit Lento vix ac vix, & male sana pede.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations in the right margin (a cross, Greek words "εὐσεβεία" and similar scribbles) and underlining over the text are manuscript additions, not printed; omitted. Greek in the head "ἐυχα-ειςτὴν θεῷ" is a doubtful reading of the printed Greek (ἐυχαρι-στὴν θεῷ); the Greek in the heading is partly obscured by underlining. Line "reddens qua ab illo bo-" and the Greek word "ἐυχα" are uncertain.
